items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: No. I don't know. You see, I keep telling him right now and then, they want to beep me down that Chinese Bebe's date.

ctx.x: John Prudence. I don't know what's his name. I can't think of his name right now. Who used to play with? He used to use the bow too. He had a band. He had a band. Where'd you live at? Downtown around, around Glen and around Park or somewhere. I don't know. Paul Barber played with him a while. LSB got played with him a while. I think Chinese played with him a while. But I know Paul Barber and LSB got played with him. Is this Chinese Bebe's date? No.
No. I don't know. You see, I keep telling him right now and then, they want to beep me down that Chinese Bebe's date.
Still drinking that one. I don't know.
